fields.title: Plan B
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each dependency, name a Plan B and what happens without it.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Recommendation service on the home screen
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Geocoding — user's saved addresses work without it, a new address is accepted with manual point selection on the map; without Plan B, new addresses cannot be entered. Recommendations — fallback to popular items; without Plan B, the home screen is empty, which is worse than being non-personalized. Payment — cash on delivery; without Plan B, revenue stops. Promo codes — honest error message "verification is temporarily unavailable", without Plan B the entire checkout is blocked for an optional feature, and this is the worst of the four options.
